# lowkey.tools

> Tiny, free, offline-first tools and instant games. No signup, nothing to install. Useful things that run in your browser.

Canonical hub: https://lowkey.tools/

No accounts or mandatory installation. Offline capability is marked per tool. FuseLLM sends prompts directly to user-selected AI providers; provider usage may cost money. The hub uses cookie-free OwlEye Analytics for page views, card impressions, clicks and load speed, without cookies, browser storage, search terms or tool content.

## Featured

- [FuseLLM](https://fusellm.lowkey.tools/): Your models. Better together.. Live; Advanced · BYOK.

## Apps

- [SuperBrain](https://superbrain.lowkey.tools/): Local-first notes, zero setup. Live; Installable · works offline.
- [SuperSplit](https://supersplit.lowkey.tools/): Split bills. Keep the peace.. Live; Installable · works offline.
- [SuperFocus](https://superfocus.lowkey.tools/): A little focus goes far. Live; Installable · works offline.
- [StreakFreak](https://streakfreak.lowkey.tools/): Small habits. Longer streaks.. Live; Installable · works offline.
- [Credo](https://credo.lowkey.tools): Share secrets, keep them secret. Live.
- [Converteasy](https://converteasy.lowkey.tools/): Everyday conversions, without the fuss. Live.
- [Favigen](https://favigen.lowkey.tools/): One image. Every favicon.. Live.
- [Billbook](https://billbook.lowkey.tools/): Invoices made easy, kept local. Live; Installable · works offline.
